protocol: Same user message as Qwen handover, rendered with native LFM template and tokenized with parse_special=true and add_special=false. Two fresh servers per arm and budget, alternating order on the second pass. Eight input/eight output warmup; uncached 64-token greedy completion with seed 42 and ignore_eos. Times are measured at the HTTP client: POST to first token, 63 token intervals divided by first-to-last elapsed seconds, and POST to end of stream. Independent per-metric medians; largest macOS lifetime process footprint per condition. Model startup excluded. One server at a time. Ordinary attention, no draft. The diagnostic widens the real partial block and binds already-resident expert layers to the graph. Both changes are measured together.
